title: Unsafe decoding via read-string (clojure) — review required
description: The clojure call read-string rebuilds objects from bytes. Hostile input instantiates unexpected classes. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms trust or hardens via clojure.edn with readers off.
remediation: Harden with clojure.edn with readers off.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any read-string call matches.
